title.zh: 气体输运：先均匀送到再反应
title.en: Gas transport: deliver uniformly before reacting

subtitle.zh: 供气 /输运 /消耗 / 排气

body.zh: 01；配气；多种工艺气体；按比例混合；稳定供给
body.en: 01 Gas mixing Multiple process gases are mixed in proportion and supplied steadily

body.zh: 02；分区进气；喷淋头多区分布；使气体在径向上；尽量均匀
body.en: 02 Zoned gas inlet Multiple showerhead zones make radial gas delivery as uniform as possible

body.zh: 03；等离子体解离；气体在等离子体中；碰撞解离，生成；活性物种
body.en: 03 Plasma dissociation Gas collides and dissociates in the plasma, generating reactive species

body.zh: 04；径向输运；活性物种在气流；与扩散作用下；从中心向边缘输运
body.en: 04 Radial transport Reactive species are transported by gas flow and diffusion from center to edge

body.zh: 05；表面消耗；活性物种在晶圆表面；发生反应并被消耗；浓度沿径向降低
body.en: 05 Surface consumption Reactive species at the wafer surface react and are consumed so concentration decreases radially

body.zh: 06；副产物排出；反应生成的副产物；被气流带走；从下方抽气排出
body.en: 06 Byproduct removal Reaction byproducts are carried by gas flow and exhausted from below

body.zh: 中心快/边缘慢；环形异常；副产物富集
body.en: Fast center / slow edge Annular anomaly Byproduct accumulation

body.zh: 对称抽气；晶圆；对称抽气
中心/边缘流量；中心区；边缘区
body.en: Center / edge flow Center zone Edge zone

body.zh: 调流量或压力，会同时改变自由基、停留时间与碰撞
body.en: Changing flow or pressure also changes radicals, residence time and collisions

body.zh: 量测反馈：深度图/ OES /压力与MFC趋势
body.en: Metrology feedback: depth map / OES / pressure and MFC trends

topic: 刻蚀均匀性与腔体控制
